description_en: Queries information about one or more EIAM applications by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询一个或者多个EIAM应用信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam list-applications --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --application-ids app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --application-name Ram_Account_SSO --authorization-type authorize_required --status enabled --m2m-client-status enabled --resource-server-status enabled --sso-type oauth2/m2m --application-creation-type system_init --application-identity-type application --application-template-id apt_ramuser_xxxx --custom-fields FieldValue=x-claw FieldName=agent_type --service-managed true --managed-service-code waf --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplications

parameters.help_en: The application name. Only left fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称，只支持左模糊匹配
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.help_en:
The application access authorization type. Valid values:
authorize_required: Explicit authorization is required for access.
default_all: All members have access permissions by default
parameters.help_zh:
应用访问授权类型，取值可选范围：
authorize_required：需要显式授权才可访问。
default_all：默认所有成员具备访问权限
parameters.name: authorization_type

parameters.help_en:
The application status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
应用状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：启用中。
disabled：禁用中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the M2M Client identity is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 用于判断是否启用了M2M Client身份
parameters.name: m2m_client_status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the ResourceServer capability is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 用于判断是否启用了ResourceServer能力
parameters.name: resource_server_status

parameters.help_en: The SSO type filter condition. Multiple types can be separated by commas. Example: oauth2/m2m,oidc+oauth2/m2m
parameters.help_zh: SSO类型检索条件（多个类型支持以英文逗号分隔传参，示例：oauth2/m2m,oidc+oauth2/m2m）
parameters.name: sso_type

parameters.help_en: The application creation type. If this parameter is left empty, applications of the user_custom type are queried by default. To query applications of all types, set this parameter to all
parameters.help_zh: 应用创建类型（为空时默认查询user_custom用户创建类型的应用，查询所有类型应用传：all）
parameters.name: application_creation_type

parameters.help_en: The application identity type. If this parameter is left empty, applications of the application type are queried by default. To query applications of all identity types, set this parameter to all
parameters.help_zh: 应用身份类型（为空时默认查询application类型，查询所有身份类型传：all）
parameters.name: application_identity_type

fields.help_en:
The custom field identifier. Valid values:
agent_type: The agent type
fields.help_zh:
扩展字段标识，取值可选范围：
agent_type：Agent类型
fields.name: field_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the application template is managed by a cloud service
parameters.help_zh: 应用模板是否被云产品托管
parameters.name: service_managed

parameters.help_en: The ServiceCode of the cloud service that manages the application template
parameters.help_zh: 托管应用模板的云产品ServiceCode
parameters.name: managed_service_code

ApplicationSourceType.description_en:
The application creation source. Valid values:
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template: Application template.
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard: Standard protocol
ApplicationSourceType.description_zh:
应用创建来源，取值可选范围：
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template：应用模板。
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard：标准协议

ClientId.description_en: The client ID of the application

CreateTime.description_en: The application creation time, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 应用创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Features.description_en:
The features supported by the application, returned as a JSON array string. Valid values:
sso: Single sign-on.
slo: Single logout.
provision: Account synchronization.
api_invoke: API access. 
m2m_client: M2M Client capability.
resource_server: API service capability.
other: Fallback
Features.description_zh:
应用支持的功能特性，JSON数组格式字符串返回。取值可选范围：
sso：单点登录。
slo：单点登出。
provision：账户同步。
api_invoke：API开放。 
m2m_client：M2M Client能力。
resource_server：API服务能力。
other：兜底

LogoUrl.description_en: The URL of the application logo

ManagedServiceCode.description_en: The ServiceCode of the cloud service that manages the application template
ManagedServiceCode.description_zh: 托管应用模板的云产品ServiceCode
ManagedServiceCode.title_zh: 托管应用模板的云产品ServiceCode

ResourceServerIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the ResourceServer

ServiceManaged.description_en: Specifies whether the application template is managed by a cloud service
ServiceManaged.description_zh: 应用模板是否被云产品托管
ServiceManaged.title_zh: 应用模板是否被云产品托管

SsoType.description_en:
The single sign-on protocol. Valid values:
saml2: SAML 2.0 protocol.
oidc: OpenID Connect protocol.
oauth2/m2m: OAuth 2.0 protocol.
oidc+oauth2/m2m: OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 protocols
SsoType.description_zh:
单点登录协议，可选范围：
saml2：SAML 2.0 协议。
oidc：OpenID Connect 协议。
oauth2/m2m：OAuth2.0协议。
oidc+oauth2/m2m：OpenID Connect和OAuth2.0协议

Status.description_en:
The application status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled.
deleted: Soft deleted
Status.description_zh:
应用状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：启用中。
disabled：禁用中。
deleted： 软删除

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the application was last updated, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 应用最近更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
